simulation.attestation: full replay on every npm test: all 27,000,000 Pass 1 rounds regenerated from the pinned seeds, census and running RTP exact, other derived figures at the reproduction tolerance; npm run test:full also regenerates the artifact into outputs/run/ and diffs it
simulation.note: The Pass 1 experiment is deterministic: npm run simulate re-derives outputs/simulation-results.json from the pinned SIM_SEEDS in src/sim-seeds.ts, and the run is compared against the committed artifact at the reproduction tolerance (outputs/run/diff.json). Step 19 re-derives RTP, standard error, chi-squared and its p-value from the committed histograms rather than reading the artifact's own scalars, and, since 24 September 2026, replays all 27,000,000 rounds from the pinned seeds (src/pass1.ts, the generator's own loop): the census, simulatedRTP and all 189 running-RTP points must come back exactly and the other derived figures within tolerance. No artifact of record carries run metadata, so every integer, string and count reproduces exactly; only the last bits of a few derived floats move across CPUs, which is what the tolerance is for.
